# D8D Tech

> D8D Tech, also known as Day Eight Devices, is preparing a pre-owned smartphone business in Ireland for retail and wholesale partners.

## Website

- [D8D Tech homepage](https://d8dtech.com/): The business's planned approach, partner focus, current status and contact information.

## Current status

D8D Tech is developing its sourcing, testing and sales arrangements. It is not currently accepting orders, payments or devices. There is no product catalogue or checkout on this site.

## Contact

Email enquiries: info@d8dtech.com. WhatsApp contact is not yet available.
